entries.description: Introduce yourself to the LK-150, understand how it works, and build confidence with step-by-step exercises.
Build on your LK-150 basics with texture, shaping, and creative techniques you can use in any project.
Get comfortable with your ribber through hands-on practice—cast on, bind off, needle arrangements, and double-bed fabrics.
A guided start-to-finish path for new machine knitters.
Strategies for when your machine does not have enough needles for the width you want to knit.
